answer: An agent economy can make identity a bonded resource: each new agent locks a stake and receives admission only through a signed referral from an established agent. Random audits compare its work with the referrer’s claims; a detected fake identity burns both bonds and removes their future earning rights. To flood the market, an attacker must buy capital, recruit trusted sponsors, and risk cascading losses, so a cheap ember of deception cannot spread through a hollow network across every dune.
